decisions.reason: The cap is a simple, low-cost accessory that builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how and supports after-sales revenue, though its absence from the website since 2020 suggests it is becoming less visible.

Box trailers are the firm's core competence, so it can read market feedback and improve the series in-house, even if its absence from the website since 2020 points to possible model renaming or updating.
The low-bed series draws closely on existing design and production skills, so the firm can learn from its results and keep refining it, despite the recent lack of web presence.
High covers complement the box trailers, use known materials and processes, and sell through existing channels, so keeping them is low-risk.

This series fits the firm's core knowledge, but its overlap with Product B and its absence from the website raise the chance that the two lines are consolidated, so it is kept for now while that is reviewed.
